mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 3.5% signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their 12-month medians signal broad consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (2017=100) indicates manufacturing sector contraction, increasing input costs and reducing corporate profits, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index above 330 signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 330, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST) above 1300 thousand units indicate robust consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1300, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment below 155,000 thousand indicates labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS < 155000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales below 730,000 million dollars signals weak consumer spending, reducing corporate earnings and predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS < 730000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
